data.name: Storage.Evicted
data.value: x86: the browser erased the storage of Os-x86 ({0:d}): the downloaded images and what the virtual machines had written on their disks are lost; they will start again from their image, downloaded again.

data.name: Storage.PersistenceLost
data.value: x86: the browser no longer protects the storage of Os-x86 from being erased; Settings ▸ Storage tells more.
